# m1c2

> m1c2 is the product studio of Zak Hap, a New York programmer who studied computer science and music composition at Columbia. Motto: measure once, cut twice.

The site is drawn as the inside of a tesseract in HTML and CSS only; each page of content is a 600px square on one wall. The text is ordinary HTML and reads fine without the styling.

## Writings

- [Studio Practice Tenets](https://m1c2.xyz/tenets.html): the studio's working principles
- [Latent Space as Medium](https://m1c2.xyz/latent-space-as-medium.html): the latent space of LLMs as our defining medium (May 2025)
- [Notes on Signatures](https://m1c2.xyz/signatures.html): identity and mark-making in the digital age (May 2025)
- [The Tyranny of Pre-digestion](https://m1c2.xyz/tyranny-of-pre-digestion.html): the costs of consuming pre-processed information (May 2025)
